main_measure.name: Mean 5-day excess return, top fifth of positive forecasts minus all other grid bars
main_measure.threshold: Welch t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check); Welch t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: Top-fifth mean excess minus remaining positive-forecast mean excess

decided_by: Welch t >= 2 (top fifth minus the rest) and the supporting check passes.
reading: The top fifth is the positive-forecast grid bars whose forecast is at or above the 80th percentile of positive grid forecasts (ties at the cut kept in the top group), the coin's mean 5-day return is taken over its non-overlapping grid in all windows, and the plan's minimum of 30 top-fifth cases gives 'not observable' when unmet.
